name: dogsprite-mcp-server
description: MCP server for programmatic pixel art generation in DogSprite

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s='src/game/export/runtime-js';const d='dist/game/export/runtime-js';if(fs.existsSync(s)){fs.cpSync(s,d,{recursive:true});console.log('Copied runtime-js to dist/')}"
